description: The gentlest beginner push-up progression teaching proper pushing mechanics and upper-body control against a wall.
setup: Stand arm's length facing a wall with feet hip-width apart and palms flat on the wall at shoulder height.
steps: Step back slightly onto the balls of your feet to lean gently into the wall.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the wall in a straight plank posture.
Gently tap forehead or chest close to the wall.
Press firmly through your palms to return to full arm extension.
cues: Keep your body straight like an angled board from heels to head
Keep elbows tucked diagonally at 45 degrees rather than flared out

mistakes.mistake: Bending at the hips and leaving glutes behind
mistakes.fix: Tuck pelvis and move whole body toward wall as a single rigid unit

mistakes.mistake: Placing hands too high on the wall
mistakes.fix: Align hands at shoulder height or slightly below chest line

rep_standard: Begins with arms extended against wall, lowers until nose or chest is within two inches of wall, and pushes back to full lockout.
